confluxRumor0.text: Phoenixes are the most powerful creature of the Confluxes.

confluxRumor1.text: I've heard the residents of the Conflux will summon an Aurora Borealis to honor any hero who brings them the Grail.

confluxRumor2.text: Sprites are so fast that no one can hope to retaliate them.

confluxRumor3.text: The most powerful Elementals can protect their allies from their very element.

confluxRumor4.text: Those who fought Magic Elementals say magic cannot do them harm.

confluxRumor5.text: It is said some spells are more effective against Elementals than other ones.

confluxRumor6.text: Phoenixes are not the most powerful creatures, but they are the only ones who can rise from the ashes.

confluxRumor7.text: Psychic and Magic Elementals are capable of fighting with a plenty of foes at once.

confluxRumor8.text: The attacks of Elementals are particularly dangerous for the Elementals belonging to the opposite element.

confluxRumor9.text: It can be hard to find teachers who are able to teach you elemental magic, but in the University of Conflux you can learn the magic of any element.

confluxRumor10.text: Traveling the highlands, remember about the Hermits living there. It is said they can teach to striding heroes many things.

confluxRumor11.text: The Conflux Elementals obey to the four Elemental Lords.

confluxRumor12.text: I have heard many centuries ago Elementals invaded the lands of Erathia.
